featuredProjects.title: World of Zombies
featuredProjects.description:
World of Zombies was an independent game project inspired by my favorite Call of Duty Zombies game mode. I was fascinated by its storytelling, hidden lore, and environmental clues that encouraged exploration and discovery. Over the course of approximately eight months-working after school and on weekends I had worked on World of Zombies, and launched it on the Mac App Store in mid 2014. 

The game launched with two playable maps, House and Swamp, each featuring distinct environments, special event rounds, and unique boss encounters that rewarded players with ammo and supply drops upon defeat.
